children: (Nasdaq: TREO) (“Tactical” or the “Company”), a U.S.-focused rare earth elements company, today announced that Chief Executive Officer Ranjeet Sundher will ring the Nasdaq Closing Bell on Thursday, September 3, 2026 at the Nasdaq MarketSite in Times Square, marking the Company’s recent debut on the Nasdaq Capital Market.

Tactical is advancing the Peak Project, a rare earth elements project located within the active Sierra Blanca Quarry in Hudspeth County, Texas. The project benefits from existing infrastructure, previously mined and accessible rare earth-enriched material, and a unique mineralogical profile that supports simplified, clean processing.

Tactical’s common shares began trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market on August 20, 2026 under the ticker symbol “TREO”, following the completion of its business combination with Plum Acquisition Corp. III.

“Ringing the Nasdaq Closing Bell is a proud moment for everyone who has been part of this journey,” said Ranjeet Sundher, Chief Executive Officer of Tactical Resources. “America needs its own rare earth supply, and we are building it in West Texas. Standing in Times Square as a U.S.-listed company puts us where our asset and our end market are. Now the real work begins.”
Ceremony Details
What:
Tactical Resources Corp. Nasdaq Closing Bell Ceremony
When:
Thursday, September 3, 2026 – 3:45 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET
Where:
Nasdaq MarketSite | Times Square, New York City
Who:
Ranjeet Sundher, Chief Executive Officer, joined by members of the Tactical Resources leadership team, board and shareholders
Ranjeet Sundher will be available for interviews before and after the ceremony.
About Tactical Resources

Tactical Resources is a natural resources company focused on rare earth elements critical to advanced technologies, including semiconductors, electric vehicles, robotics, aerospace systems, and national defense applications. The Company is advancing the Peak Project in Hudspeth County, Texas, as part of its strategy to help build a secure domestic supply chain, reduce reliance on foreign-controlled sources and strengthen North American critical mineral security.

Tactical Resources is also pursuing innovative metallurgical processing and separation technologies designed to improve the economics, scalability, and sustainability of rare earth production. Through this integrated approach, the Company aims to become a key participant in the rapidly growing U.S. critical minerals ecosystem.
